title: Wayfare Pro Programme Terms, Part 4: Pro Boost on Locked Earnings Guarantees
content:
**4.1** A locked guarantee recorded on a **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** earnings guarantee opt-in carries a Pro boost: the guaranteed amount stated on the offer is multiplied by one plus the Pro boost. That multiplication acts on the stated amount together with every other multiplier of it; amounts added to the locked guarantee are added after it, and the locked guarantee is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**4.2** The Pro boost follows the Wayfare Pro status recorded on the earnings account for the current quarter, the Pro points the account has earned in the current quarter and whether its payouts are on hold:

- Wayfare Pro Platinum, Diamond or Diamond Elite with at least 300 points this quarter on an account whose payouts are not on hold earns 0.08;
- Wayfare Pro Silver or Gold with at least 30 points this quarter on an account whose payouts are not on hold earns 0.04;
- any other status, fewer points, or an account on payout hold earns no boost.

**4.3** The Pro points read are those credited to the account for the current quarter; points of an earlier quarter do not count.

## Part 4 as a truth table

| Status recorded for the current quarter | Pro points this quarter | Payouts on hold? | Pro boost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Platinum, Diamond or Diamond Elite | 300 or more | No | 0.08 |
| Platinum, Diamond or Diamond Elite | 300 or more | Yes | None |
| Platinum, Diamond or Diamond Elite | Fewer than 300 | Either | None |
| Silver or Gold | 30 or more | No | 0.04 |
| Silver or Gold | 30 or more | Yes | None |
| Silver or Gold | Fewer than 30 | Either | None |
| Blue | Any | Either | None |

## Edges (hypothetical accounts, payouts not on hold)

| Status | Points this quarter | Pro boost |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pro Diamond | 300 | 0.08 |
| Wayfare Pro Diamond | 299 | None |
| Wayfare Pro Gold | 30 | 0.04 |
| Wayfare Pro Gold | 29 | None |

**Hypothetical figure.** A stated guaranteed amount of 200.00 for a Wayfare Pro Platinum account with 412 points this quarter and payouts not on hold becomes 216.00 under the Pro boost (200.00 multiplied by 1.08); the same account while its payouts are on hold earns no boost, 200.00.
